lobelia.design: An elderly English hobbit gentlewoman in her seventies: thin, sharp and slightly nasal, prim upper-class rural English accent, quick clipped delivery, sniffy, indignant and grasping.

ferny.design: A middle-aged man of Bree: low, nasal and sneering, rough rural English accent, slow insolent pace, sour and spiteful.

rosie.design: A young hobbit woman in her twenties: light, warm and bright, soft rural English accent, easy unhurried pace, friendly with a shy smile in it.

gaffer.design: An old hobbit gardener in his seventies: gravelly and slow, broad rural West Country English burr, grumbling and opinionated but fatherly.

beregond.design: A guardsman of Gondor in his forties: warm, steady baritone, measured and slightly formal English, unhurried, kindly but grave.

breelander.design: A middle-aged townsman of Bree: ruddy, gruff but friendly, broad rural northern English accent, medium pace, gossipy and a little wary of strangers.
